annotation.title_clean: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Ministry of Justice (Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs, Economic Law Department)
annotation.summary_en: English summary of Israel's December 2023 first national AI regulation and ethics policy for the private sector. It identifies seven challenges (discrimination, oversight, explainability, disclosure, safety, accountability, privacy) and recommends sectoral, risk-based regulation, soft tools, public-private cooperation and international alignment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adopt sectoral regulation led by sector-specific regulators
Use a risk-based approach and soft regulatory tools for incremental development
Align with OECD and leading countries' approaches
Establish an AI Policy Coordination Center, inter-agency and multistakeholder forums
Develop a government risk management tool and engage in international standards forums
